The most intense peak (base peak) is at m/z 121.0528, which is likely the molecular ion peak (M+). This suggests that the molecular weight of the compound is approximately 121. 

Given the molecular weight and the common elements in organic compounds (C, H, O, N), I will deduce the molecular formula. A common molecular formula with a molecular weight close to 121 is C8H9O, which has a molecular weight of 121.15 g/mol.
